name: clean-temp
description: Clear stale temporary files inside a scoped temp directory.
preconditions: target is a temp/scratch dir, never home or system
steps: verify the target path is a designated temp directory
list candidates older than the threshold (dry-run first)
delete only after user approval, then report freed space
validation: deleted paths listed; freed bytes reported
failure_recovery: stop on first permission error and report remainder
cautions: scoped temp dirs only: never home, documents, system, or hidden paths
dry-run plus approval before any delete
never follow symlinks; never delete files newer than the threshold
